en.hubeali: ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Refused except that He<sup>azwj</sup> would be Opposing the timing of the timers’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ahmad has narrated through his chain of narrators from the Imam (a.s.) the following. “
Allah disdains to make the people’s time set for it (reappearance of the one who will rise with Divine Authority) to come true.”
